headline: Colombia's Milagro Week doubled its potential investment target
summary: Potential investment commitments at Milagro Week in Colombia have doubled, with $21.8 billion from 17 companies and two conservation organizations. Projects span rail, aviation, mining and financial inclusion across 24 departments and Bogotá.
why: Investment pledges and project pipelines in transport and mining shape Colombia's medium-term growth and infrastructure spending.
original_headline: Milagro Week de Colombia duplicó meta de inversión potencial
